name: Zillow
summary: Zillow laid off just over 500 people, roughly 7% of the company, on 4 and 5 August 2026, including 91 in Washington state.

facts.label: People affected
facts.figure: just over 500 people, roughly 7% of the company
facts.detail: CEO Jeremy Wacksman called it a difficult decision the company needed in order to grow at scale.

facts.label: Washington WARN filing
facts.figure: 91 people at the Seattle site, notice dated 4 August 2026
facts.detail: WARN is the public notice an employer files with the state ahead of a large layoff. It counts one state, so it is smaller than the company-wide figure.
facts.source_name: Washington WARN filings via WARN Firehose
